answer_1.quote: Voice conversion (VC) aims to transform the speaker's timbre in speech to match that of a target speaker while preserving the original speech content.

answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics We evaluate the model with objective metrics including cosine distance (SECS), character error rate (CER), word error rate (WER) for zero-shot voice conversion, and emotion score from a pre-trained emotion representation model for style transfer.

answer_4.quote: For subjective evaluation, MOS assessments are conducted via Amazon Mechanical Turk, focusing on QMOS (quality, clarity, naturalness) and SMOS (speaker similarity)... Each generated audio has been listened to by at least 10 native listeners.
answer_4.guideline: Listeners rate speech samples using a Likert scale for QMOS (quality, clarity, naturalness) and SMOS (speaker similarity).
